newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal says lawsuit 'without merit'.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal says lawsuit 'without merit'.

text.p: Molten Medtal Technology Inc said Thursday a class action lawsuit alleging it misrepresented information regarding its waste processing technology and other matters was "completely without merit."
In a statement, the company said it intends to contest the suit vigorously.
Lawyers for the plaintiffs, Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, said they filed the lawsuit on Wednesday in a federal district court in Massachusetts.
Molten Metal is engaged in commercializing pollution prevention and waste recycling methods applicable to hazardous, non-hazardous and radioactive wastes.
